guarantees.claim: For each share s in {0,1} and each column x in 0..4, y in 0..4, phase2_out[s][x][y] is assigned {state_in[s][x][y][W-1:W/2], iota_data[s][x][y][W/2-1:0]} when dom_out_low_i is 1, else {iota_data[s][x][y][W-1:W/2], state_in[s][x][y][W/2-1:0]}.

assumptions.claim: Parameter W must be ≥ 2 to keep bit‑select W/2-1:0 non‑negative.
assumptions.risk: Out‑of‑range part select causes elaboration error or X propagation.

uncertain_points.claim: dom_out_low_i is a combinatorial mux control; glitches may propagate to phase2_out and be sampled by downstream logic.
uncertain_points.cond: when dom_out_low_i toggles near a downstream sampling event
uncertain_points.risk: Transient incorrect concatenation appears on phase2_out, potentially consuming a wrongly‑shaped masked word.
